title: ～も — “also / too”
summary: A particle used to say that the same applies to something else as well. It replaces は, が or を.

patterns.gloss: noun + にも / でも / とも

body.p: Against 私は学生です, 私も学生です says “me too.” は, が and を are replaced by も and not used together.
に, で and と remain and become にも, でも, とも (東京にも行きます).
After a quantity, も stresses that it is a lot (五人も来ました = as many as five).

examples.ja: 私（わたし）も学生（がくせい）です。
私（わたし）も行（い）きます。

pitfalls: Do not stack particles like 私もは.
も assumes a previous statement it matches.
